rules.sentence: Diagnosis of S-UC requires at least one of the following criteria: The detection of epithelial origin should be demonstrated morphologically or by cytokeratin expression immunohistochemically.
Another criterion is the detection of immunohistochemical GATA3 expression especially in the sarcomatous component.
A large study of 489 S-UCs revealed that patients who underwent RC alone and those who received NAC or AC had similar survival outcomes.
The poor response of sarcomatoid UC to chemotherapy has been confirmed by some other studies.
Contrary to these, it has also been reported that NAC provides a survival advantage in these patients.
Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma presents at an advanced stage more frequently than CUC and is associated with worse survival.
